title: United in Diversity? Contextual Biases in LLM-Based Predictions of the 2024 European Parliament Elections
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the predictive accuracy and contextual biases of LLMs in the context of political elections (specifically the 2024 European Parliament elections). While it touches on the social implications of bias and alignment with human values, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems.
